homepageTopArticles.title: Growth across all regions: Pandora reports solid third-quarter sales increase
homepageTopArticles.snippet:
Pandora flagship store in Copenhagen Image: Pandora

Danish jewellery retailer Pandora A/S has further increased its revenue in the third quarter of the 2026 financial year, despite challenging market conditions. Profit was also higher than in the prior-year period, according to an interim report published by the company on Wednesday.
homepageTopArticles.aiSummary: Pandora increased third-quarter revenue across all regions in 2026, with profit also rising from a year earlier despite challenging market conditions.

homepageTopArticles.title: Revolve’s Q3 Profits Slip Despite 20% Sales Increase
homepageTopArticles.snippet: But logistics costs contributed to lower profits at the e-commerce company targeting Millennials and Gen Z.
homepageTopArticles.aiSummary: Revolve’s Q3 profits fell despite a 20% sales increase, with logistics costs contributing to the decline.

homepageTopArticles.title: Pandora Raises 2026 Outlook as U.S. Sales Rebound
homepageTopArticles.snippet: Buoyed by improved sales in the United States and strong growth in Asia-Pacific, Pandora reported 6% organic revenue growth in the third quarter, prompting the jewelry giant to narrow its full-year forecast toward the upper end of its previous range. The company said on Nov. 4 that quarterly revenue rose 7% to 6.69 billion Danish…
homepageTopArticles.aiSummary: Pandora narrowed its full-year outlook toward the upper end of its previous range after third-quarter organic revenue grew 6%, supported by improved U.S. sales.

homepageTopArticles.title: What DoorDash’s proposed acquisition of Instacart means for Uber, Amazon and the rest of the quick commerce space
homepageTopArticles.snippet: The race to be the go-to platform for shoppers when they want products delivered quickly is about to get a lot more cutthroat after DoorDash announced its intent to acquire Instacart last week. Here's what it means for the quick commerce space, and other formidable players like Uber and Amazon.
homepageTopArticles.aiSummary: DoorDash announced plans to acquire Instacart, intensifying competition with Uber and Amazon for shoppers seeking fast delivery.
